en.projection: The four Web source profiles lower ExposedState Host projection into a standalone supporting helper. Names use the State semantic, falling back to the exposure key, and share the existing Module’s official aliases and normalization. Boolean true adds an empty attribute and false removes it; string/enum values write attributes, discrete numbers write attributes and CSS variables, and continuous numbers write only CSS variables by default. The JavaScript compile APIs accept the existing exposeStateWebMode flags allowStringVar and allowContinuousAttr. This is a Web extension, not a DOM projection promise for GPUI, Qt or Flutter.
en.evidence: The ExposedState repair separately mounts all four original Web Adapters alongside generated native consumers: 18 scalar/mirror surfaces exercise writes without structural rendering, real detach and retained-State remount; eight readonly surfaces exercise actual focus/blur and continuous Scroll projection. Actual WASM Worker comparison covers 23 successful complete outputs, the Web-only GPUI mode rejection, six unimplemented-profile rejections and four malformed mode requests. Earlier failed observations and corrected driver mistakes remain recorded. Canonical Web Component Root markers and native Scroll projection markers still differ, so these bounded observations are not complete Adapter parity or RuntimeBox migration.

en.ownership: Static Module declarations select the physical Root before rendering, but only an invoked hook activates its image or text properties. Inactive declarations must not overwrite consumer-owned alternative text, image fit or editing values. Generated Custom Elements mark the connected canonical host with data-pui-root, not a template child or physical image/input part; their constructors do not add host attributes. Activated Scroll surfaces expose the negotiated data-pui-scroll-projection marker, measured position/visible-ratio facts and view-scoped readiness. Detach returns the projection to unresolved; remount renegotiates the live Root. TextControl owns the client editing value, without a competing Vue 2 or Vue 3 VNode writer. Explicit updates preserve a composing value and composition end restores the controlled value; server serialization retains its separate value path.
en.evidence: The follow-up compiles seven controlled Prototype fixtures through the actual browser WASM Worker to all four Web source profiles: 28 complete outputs match Node, then the unmodified emitted modules mount beside their original Adapters as 56 real surfaces. Evidence covers inactive/active image and input declarations, controlled editing, ordered template children, measured Scroll requests, detach/remount and terminal cleanup. Composition events are synthetic events in Chromium, not OS/IME automation. The shared stylesheet supplies geometry only; it does not inject Module values, Root markers, overflow policy or Scroll facts. Raw attributes, markup and remaining Custom Element presentation differences are retained in internal/compiler/browser-wasm-evidence.json. This does not admit native widgets, SSR/hydration profiles, every canonical Demo, RuntimeBox mounting or an editor/security boundary.

english.title: Compiler Guide | Proto UI
english.paragraph: An additional Root review repair delivers Scroll’s system → unresolved notification during physical detach, including the authored watcher, without reopening input or terminal-owner guards. Four original/generated Web pairs exercise detach and retained-owner remount; seven complete browser Worker outputs match Node. The Custom Element Root marker is acquired only when the validated port accepts an owner, then restored on disposal unless the consumer has replaced it. Required-Context initialization failure and two shared-port hydration mismatches leave no generated Root marker or owner; an actual provider permits a fresh client owner. Existing marker baselines and later consumer writes survive disposal. These port checks use the unadmitted private serializer only to reproduce the shared client helper; they do not admit SSR/hydration. Raw event reasons, terminal notification differences and the original Web Component Adapter’s failed-initialization marker/recovery gap remain recorded. All fourteen reproduction containers are empty after disposal, eight retained getters reject, and the four intentional initialization errors are retained separately from unexpected errors.

decisions: String enum requires a nonempty literal string options array; empty options and non-enum options are blocking descriptor errors.

Missing skips prevValid; provided empty accept resolves null without replacing prevValid; empty fallback and non-empty invalid use prevValid then latest defaults, declaration default and canonical null.
Only empty error requires a nonempty valid fallback.
Same-key narrowing is rejected; enum widening is admitted; existing default and stricter existing empty policy are retained.
Keep compiler profiles and draft/stable boundaries unchanged; remaining canonical graph rejections are explicit obligations.
authority.evidence: Use actual browser WASM compiler bytes, exact generated source and original Adapter differential observations; retain negative traces.
authority.nonGoals: This bounded Props increment does not close #817, implement missing native widgets or claim website migrations, SSR/hydration or preview sandbox completion.
authority.originalAdapterRepair: Actual original Vue3/Vue2 default-policy + authored-watch update loses a reentrantly installed completion signal when the previous commit clears its shared pointer after signal.done. Two real consumer regressions fail Second != Third before source repair. Capture and clear only the owned completion before callbacks/await; no props normalization, rendering policy, native API or grammar change.

authorization.purpose: Continue full #817 and the native, SSR/hydration and Adapter parity portfolio. This owned candidate admits canonical string enum Props and enforces governed empty/fallback and declaration shape/merge behavior through the existing compiler pipeline; no profile promotion, release, self-approval or bypass. Includes source-level repair of original Vue3/Vue2 reentrant commit ownership observed by this same canonical Props differential; retain all prior failures, default host-policy and disabled-auto-update contracts. No release or new stable guarantee.

changeLog: Preserve authored scalar string-enum descriptors and options metadata while keeping callback scalar typing valid across later superset declarations.
Validate canonical descriptor/default shape for source operations and external checked IR; reject illegal narrowing and malformed descriptor/default values at their actual source boundary.
Resolve missing from latest default layers; preserve previous valid history only for provided-empty/invalid fallback, with independent history per key. Accepted empty does not erase history.
Repeated declarations retain the established default and stricter empty policy, merge atomically, reject enum/range narrowing and emit widening/default diagnostics only after successful commit.

Capture and clear the original Vue3/Vue2 completion signal before async work and callbacks, so old completion cannot erase a reentrant next commit. Keep host auto-update and disabled-auto-update semantics unchanged.

english.title: Compiler Guide | Proto UI

paragraphs.text: Canonical scalar Props now preserve the author contract across source admission, checked-IR validation and the five implemented source targets. String enums retain their options as descriptor metadata, including an empty-string option; a later superset declaration does not invalidate an earlier watcher. Descriptor/default validation and repeated declaration merging are atomic: the established default and stricter empty policy survive, narrowing rejects, and widening diagnostics are emitted only after a successful merge. Missing keys use the latest defaults without reusing previous host values. Provided empty or invalid values follow their declared policy and independent per-key previous-valid fallback; an accepted empty value does not erase that history.

The source-bound Props run compiles three controlled fixtures and the canonical Base Scrollbar/Tabs List graphs through the actual browser WASM Worker to four Web profiles and GPUI: 25 complete outputs match Node. Four original/generated Web consumers exercise the controlled fixtures and canonical Scrollbar as 32 real surfaces / 68 step observations, with matching desired values and change payloads before and after explicit public updates. The original Vue 3/Vue 2 repair first reproduces a lost queued commit: completing one commit may synchronously install the next signal, so each Adapter must capture and clear only its own signal before callbacks. The repair preserves host auto-update policy and disabled-auto-update conformance. All 32 containers are empty after disposal, with no captured errors. Earlier stale-Vue observations and incorrect driver assumptions remain in the evidence ledger rather than being rewritten as passes.

The actual GPUI headless-window consumer separately exercises provided-empty, missing and invalid canonical Props through creation, physical commit, set_props and terminal disposal. Its generated Rust and SDK source remain byte-identical after the Web repair; no repeated native build or native enum/range-widget breadth is inferred. Canonical Tabs List’s graph compiles, but its required real Tabs provider preview is not yet exercised. These observations do not establish full raw-DOM/terminal-event Adapter parity, complete native targets, SSR/hydration admission or a migrated RuntimeBox/editor/security boundary.

english.inventory: internal/compiler/website-demo-migrations.json records every demo-bearing MDX documentation page, homepage/library/Matrix expansion, demo declaration, registration binding and canonical prototype definition. It follows imported Astro wrappers, including both UiLibraryGallery mounts, and retains the underlying preview’s file/line address. Literal equality choices resolve finite template-generated demo IDs without executing author scripts; unresolved dynamic mount attributes remain explicit row obligations. It reuses the Website’s manifest-exported source resolver and records actual canonical Node admission diagnostics rather than substituting an Adapter. The current inventory has 122 pages, 65 demo declarations and 145 prototype definitions; five definitions pass the selected Web Component source profile and 140 are rejected by current source admission. Canonical Base Scrollbar and Tabs List join the earlier three admitted definitions; this is not page migration. All registration/source addresses are resolved. No page is excluded merely because compilation fails.

chinese.title: Compiler 指南 | Proto UI

paragraphs.text: Canonical scalar Props 现在通过 source admission、checked-IR validation 与五个已实现 source target 保持作者契约。String enum 的 options 保留为 descriptor metadata，包括合法的 empty-string option；后续 superset declaration 不使早先注册的 watcher 失效。Descriptor/default validation 与重复 declaration merge 保持 atomic：保留最先确立的 default 和更严格的 empty policy，narrowing 拒绝，widening diagnostic 只在 merge 成功后发出。Missing key 使用最新 defaults，不复用旧 host value。Provided empty 或 invalid value 按声明 policy 与各 key 独立的 previous-valid history 回退；accepted empty 不抹掉该 history。

Source-bound Props run 在真实浏览器 WASM Worker 中，将三个受控 fixture 与 canonical Base Scrollbar/Tabs List graph 编译到四个 Web profile 和 GPUI：25 份完整 output 与 Node 一致。四组原/generated Web consumer 将受控 fixture 与 canonical Scrollbar 实际挂载为 32 个 surface / 68 组 step observation；default host update 与显式 public update 后的 desired value 和 change payload 均一致。原 Vue 3 / Vue 2 修复先复现 lost queued commit：旧 commit completion 可能同步安装新 signal，因此 Adapter 必须在 callback 前仅捕获并清空自己持有的 signal。修复不改变 host auto-update policy，关闭 auto-update 的 conformance 仍通过。Dispose 后 32 个 container 全空，没有 captured error。早先的 stale-Vue observation 与错误 driver assumption 保留在 evidence ledger，不重写为通过。

真实 GPUI headless-window consumer 另行通过 creation、physical commit、set_props 与 terminal disposal 验证 provided-empty、missing 和 invalid canonical Props。Web 修复后，生成 Rust 与 SDK source 仍逐字节一致；不据此声称重复 native build 或 native enum/range-widget 广度。Canonical Tabs List graph 已编译，但所需真实 Tabs provider preview 尚未执行。这些观察不构成完整 raw-DOM/terminal-event Adapter parity、完整 native target、SSR/hydration 准入，也不是 RuntimeBox/editor/security boundary 的迁移。

chinese.inventory: internal/compiler/website-demo-migrations.json 记录每个含 Demo 的 MDX 文档页面、homepage/library/Matrix 展开、demo declaration、registration binding 和 canonical prototype definition。它追踪 import 的 Astro wrapper（包括两个 UiLibraryGallery mount），并保留底层 preview 的 file/line 地址。Literal equality choice 用于解析有限的 template-generated demo ID，不执行作者 script；无法解析的动态 mount attribute 保留为明确的行级义务。它复用 Website 的 manifest-exported source resolver，保存实际 canonical Node admission diagnostic，不用 Adapter 替代 compiler。当前清单覆盖 122 个页面、65 个 demo declaration、145 个 prototype definition；选择的 Web Component source profile 中，5 个 definition 准入，140 个被现有 source admission 拒绝。Canonical Base Scrollbar 与 Tabs List 加入此前三个准入 definition；这不是 page migration。Registration/source 地址均已解析；不能因编译失败就把页面排除。

english.title: Compiler Guide | Proto UI

paragraphs.text: The five implemented source targets also admit props.watchAll, props.watchRaw and props.watchRawAll, with checked string-array fields in WatchInfo. The emitted helpers preserve the existing contracts: initial application is silent, raw-all callbacks precede keyed raw callbacks, all raw callbacks precede resolved callbacks, and matching resolved callbacks share setup registration order. Comparisons use Object.is, including signed zero and host-local object identity. Top-level undefined becomes null before the frozen raw snapshot, matching Core; nested host-local values are neither copied nor promoted to portable JSON. Arbitrary opaque raw-member access remains rejected.

The source-bound watcher run compares ten complete actual WASM Worker outputs with Node, then mounts two fixtures across all four original/generated Web pairs as 16 real surfaces / 120 pair observations. Resolved payloads, signed-zero observations and authored traces match throughout, including explicit updates. Generated Vue 3 reads the normalized component props/attrs source rather than reviving a VNode-only +0 → -0 change. A separate real Vue pair verifies that repeated raw reads share the current snapshot and raw callbacks receive that snapshot; equal new objects notify, but the same retained object does not. All 18 containers are empty after disposal, eight retained State getters reject, and no errors are captured. Vue 2 raw changed-key arrays retain their different props/attrs ordering; the original observations are not sorted or rewritten, and universal raw parity is not claimed.

The original Runtime repair restores the incoming execution phase after synchronous rendering, including when rendering throws. An authored watcher may call run.update() without stripping the callback authority required by later watchers; mutation guards remain intact. Actual GPUI headless-window evidence exercises the watcher-family fixture’s groups, key metadata, unchanged/invalid/missing inputs, signed zero and terminal ownership. Its generated Rust and SDK bytes still match the tested generation; both captured GPUI artifacts are unchanged. The window proof is reused without claiming another native build or a separate identity-fixture window run. The earlier source-admission, ordering, Runtime-phase and Vue failures remain in internal/compiler/browser-wasm-evidence.json. This increment does not complete native targets, SSR/hydration, all canonical Demo admissions, or RuntimeBox/editor/security migration.

paragraphs.text: 五个已实现 source target 也准入 props.watchAll、props.watchRaw 与 props.watchRawAll，并对 WatchInfo 的 string-array field 做检查。生成 helper 保持现有契约：首次 apply 不通知，raw-all 先于 keyed raw callback，所有 raw callback 先于 resolved callback，匹配的 resolved callback 共享 setup 注册顺序。比较使用 Object.is，包括 signed zero 和 host-local object identity。Top-level undefined 在 frozen raw snapshot 前归一为 null，与 Core 一致；nested host-local value 不复制，也不提升为 portable JSON。任意 opaque raw-member access 仍被拒绝。

Source-bound watcher run 将 10 份真实 WASM Worker 完整 output 与 Node 对照，再将两个 fixture 挂载到四组原/generated Web consumer，形成 16 个真实 surface / 120 组 pair observation。Resolved payload、signed-zero observation 和 authored trace 在包括显式 update 的各步均一致。Generated Vue 3 读取 normalized component props/attrs source，不会重新唤起仅存在于 VNode 的 +0 → -0 变化。另一个真实 Vue pair 验证重复 raw read 共用当前 snapshot，raw callback 收到同一 snapshot；内容相等的新 object 会通知，同一个 retained object 不通知。Dispose 后 18 个 container 全空，8 个 retained State getter 拒绝调用，没有 captured error。Vue 2 raw changed-key array 保留其 props/attrs 顺序差异；不排序或重写原始 observation，也不宣称普遍 raw parity。

原 Runtime 修复让同步 render 完成后恢复进入前的 execution phase，render throw 时也如此。Authored watcher 调用 run.update() 不再剥夺后续 watcher 所需的 callback authority；mutation guard 保持不变。真实 GPUI headless-window evidence 覆盖 watcher-family fixture 的 group、key metadata、unchanged/invalid/missing input、signed zero 和 terminal ownership。其 generated Rust 与 SDK byte 仍与实际测试的 generation 一致，两份 captured GPUI artifact 也未改变。因此复用 window proof，不声称又执行了一次 native build 或单独运行了 identity fixture 的 window。先前 source-admission、ordering、Runtime phase 和 Vue 失败保留在 internal/compiler/browser-wasm-evidence.json。该增量不等于完整 native target、SSR/hydration、全部 canonical Demo 准入或 RuntimeBox/editor/security migration。

english.title: Compiler Guide | Proto UI
headings: No supported Compiler inputs or outputs in 0.2

paragraphs.text: Failed Runtime setup now releases Module resources while host identity capabilities remain available, preserving the original required-Context rejection. The original Custom Element rolls back failed Root, presentation, expose, controller and logical ownership; insertion below a real provider acquires a fresh owner. The original Adapter and both emitted Custom Element client entry points reject obsolete connectedCallback reactions before setup or disconnect-version retention. The browser can deliver an already-queued connected reaction after physical disconnection during light-slot materialization; this guard does not make a genuinely missing required provider optional.

The initialization run compares two complete actual WASM Worker outputs with Node, then exercises absent and consumer-owned Root baselines across four actual surfaces. Original explicit Shadow mode and generated default Light mode both preserve their failure baselines and recover the real provider’s value 10; no pixel equivalence is inferred. All four successful owners close retained getters and clear outward records at terminal disposal, with four intentional Context errors and no unexpected errors. Detached terminal Root attributes retain their different existing policies in the raw evidence. A separate real private SSR browser-wrapper consumer verifies obsolete-callback rejection, live provider acquisition and terminal closure; it does not exercise carrier adoption or admit an SSR/hydration profile. Earlier failed setup, stale connected-reaction and paired browser observations remain in the evidence ledger.

paragraphs.text: The terminal-lifetime run compares four complete actual WASM Worker outputs with Node, then mounts the unchanged emitted files beside all four original Web Adapters as eight real owners. Borrowed Scroll projection and owned State retain identity through repeatable detach/remount. At terminal disposal each active external subscription receives one {type: 'disconnect', reason: 'unmount'} with one argument and no author Run; canceled subscriptions stay silent, retained getters close, and stale DOM events do not notify. Generated React, Vue 3 and Custom Element owners now close their generic borrowed/owned subscriptions; Vue 2 remains the unchanged positive control. Terminal projection next counts remain three for each original Adapter, versus three for generated React and two for generated Vue 3, Vue 2 and Custom Elements. Raw reasons and callback/getter observations are preserved, not normalized. A throwing-consumer regression retains the first error while still closing the remaining subscriptions and States.

A separate private direct-Node emitter/kernel run serializes the same controlled fixture using real React, Vue 3, Vue 2 with its matching server renderer, and the Custom Element server port. Actual Chromium adopts all four initial Roots and template sections without replacement or recovery diagnostics, retains State identity across detach/remount, and delivers one borrowed/owned terminal disconnect per owner. All four public SSR profiles still return PUI4001 in Node and actual browser WASM; the private kernel smoke is not a fallback or new profile admission. The terminal evidence and captures are appended to internal/compiler/browser-wasm-evidence.json, retaining every earlier failure. This repair does not complete native targets, public SSR/hydration, all canonical Demo admissions, or RuntimeBox/editor/security migration.
